caseName: Century Mercantile Co. v. John Hofman Co.
caseNameFull: Century Mercantile Company, in Error v. John Hofman Company
summary: In error to the Court of Appeals of the State of New York.
attorneys: Mr. Herbert D. Bailey for plaintiff in error., Mr. John A. Barhite for defendant in error.

opinions.text: Judgment reversed upon confession of error and request of defendant in error, and cause remanded to be proceeded in according to law and justice.
